SYTECH Tracking requires Device Administrator permission to monitor failed lock screen attempts. If an unauthorized handler attempts to access this device and exceeds 3 consecutive failed PIN attempts, SYTECH initiates an offline security lockdown to prevent data theft and harvest recovery intelligence. Your personal data is encrypted and protected at all times pursuant to the Botswana Data Protection Act.
